title: Invoice/payment reconciliation
job: Reconcile split, excess, duplicate and ambiguous payments while conserving invoice balances and unallocated money.
method: Exact minor-unit arithmetic, atomic allocation validation and transaction conflict quarantine.
recovery: Provide a verified invoice allocation for ambiguous amounts; resolve transaction conflicts before applying them.
acceptance: Duplicate bank references cannot be counted twice; received equals allocated plus unallocated per currency.
novelty_scope: Algorithms and domain operations have established prior art. The evaluated contribution is the bounded executable resource and small-model integration, not invention of the underlying task.

problem_evidence.evidence: User requested inexpensive AI resources that improve completion of specific domain jobs.
The linked existing tools and their manuals document the recurring task and established solutions. No user interview or unmeasured frustration count is invented.
